metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Ivy Doorbell
records.biography_en: In The Portable Campaign, Ivy Doorbell takes the role of doorstep canvasser. “Just one very small question.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: miniature brass doorbell and one plain leaflet.

records.name: Len Posterroll
records.biography_en: In The Portable Campaign, Len Posterroll takes the role of poster crew organizer. “The corner is peeling again.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: compact bundle of rolled posters, one with a blank geometric circle.

records.name: Bert Soundbite
records.biography_en: In The Portable Campaign, Bert Soundbite takes the role of debate candidate. “I had a second sentence.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny microphone and one pie-shaped bite of a clay speech bubble.

records.name: Perry Pollneedle
records.biography_en: In The Portable Campaign, Perry Pollneedle takes the role of poll watcher. “It moved. It moved back.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small dial with a needle wobbling over three colored sections.

records.name: Jade Photoop
records.biography_en: In The Portable Campaign, Jade Photoop takes the role of photo-op planner. “Look spontaneous on three.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short viewfinder frame held to one side of the face.

records.name: Gus Balloonknot
records.biography_en: In The Portable Campaign, Gus Balloonknot takes the role of rally volunteer. “We have one balloon left.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one small round balloon attached by a short string to a handheld spool.
